title: FreeConvert 目录与页面质量审计
scope: FreeConvert 官方 sitemap、robots、首页、图片压缩页和隐私页的 XML/HTML 抽样；URL 规模不等于独立工具数，未做同文件转换。

sitemap.counting_method: Parse XML <url><loc> values; remove host, query and one recognized language prefix; count exact unique strings.
sitemap.interpretation: Counts are indexable URLs/paths. They include language variants, conversion pair pages, format pages, time/unit pages and API pages; they are not independent tools.
